title: The picture doesn't do it justice
text: The picture doesn't do it justice. First it took a long time to ship, but it was worth it. It is gorgeous and my granddaughter loves it. It is more like a comforter than a spread. It does have some tacking, but it's so fluffy and soft. Beautiful. I was concerned because the shipping was delayed, but the seller reached out to me. That's good customer service in IMO.  I would recommend this comforter and seller to a friend.
